description: Presented a public Ethereum blockchain solution designed to enhance transparency, traceability, and sustainability in agricultural supply chains.
Developed a Hyperledger Fabric-based private blockchain solution connecting landowners, investors, and farmers to improve transparency and collaboration in agriculture.

event: International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT)
project: Digital Sharecropper: Connecting Landowners, Farmers, and Investors Through Blockchain
description: Presented research addressing underutilized arable land and agricultural investment challenges through blockchain-driven transparency and decentralized collaboration.
